name: – Andreas Schieder – § 11 – Am 8
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Albania
part_text: 11. Calls on Albania to make decisive progress on the initial registration of property and on fair, commonly accepted compensation, improving the transparency of the state property register and the quality of cadastral data in the real estate register, and to ensure that the right to a fair trial and the right to effective judicial protection are respected in cases of expropriation and removal of real estate; expresses particular concern about allegations of arbitrary expropriations, pressure on property owners and opaque land-registration procedures affecting members of national minorities, including the Greek national minority; insists that property rights, effective judicial protection and the right to a fair trial must be fully guaranteed and that these matters are fundamental conditions to be respected by Albania in its relations with the EU;
